name: Heaton Bay
evidence: rec.gov 232220 per-site points on Esri: E75 (RV 36 ft) ~20 m and E76 (RV 30 ft) ~43 m over open ground to a Dillon bay's high-water beach, not confirmed as on the lake at normal pool; other pads 50+ m behind pine. Photos E66, E78, 022 show the lake. No Proximity tag. Pin was ~340 m N of the RV sites.

name: Lowry
evidence: rec.gov 232364 sites on Esri (lw1, lw2): Dillon Reservoir ~400 m N behind a treed ridge and Swan Mountain Rd; pads 2844 m vs lake ~2750 m. Photos of 17 RV sites show forest and mountains, no water (005, 007, 017-019, 022, 023 have none). 'Close proximity' is prose only.

name: Navajo State Park Windsurf Beach
evidence: CPW site map: 416-420 (pull-through 50-65 ft) on the east strip facing the reservoir; high-water break ~30-35 m east over open grass on Esri 2022; DEM puts full pool 1855 m within ~40 m. cpwshop 'Lakefront' on 401-420 and CPW 'traditionally on the water' are claims, measured at full pool only. Water ~300 m off at historic low. Held at lakeview.

name: Dark Sky River Lodge
evidence: Operator site map (rv-sites.html) has County Road 47 between the river and Upper River sites 1-4; Esri ds1 confirms the lane plus a riparian tree line. Photos RV_1-4 show the Arkansas through cottonwoods (site 4 'direct river views'); Upper sites fit to 25 ft. Lower River 6-10 and Lodge 11-15 sit behind a fence with no water in photos.

name: Vega State Park Early Settlers
evidence: cpwshop GIS points on Esri (vg1, vg3, near full pool): 113 ~34 m, 114 ~42 m, 117 ~36 m to the waterline over open grass, foot tracks only, on the lake side of the loop road; RV length 35-40 ft. DEM flat at 2431 m on a 114 transect, no climb-down. Earlier 64 m came from the OSM polygon. Other pads sit farther back.

name: Arkansas River Rim
evidence: Operator drone photo, gallery, map.pdf and Esri rr1-rr2: RV rows 3-38 on a flat by US-24, a continuous conifer band 20-30 m thick between them and the river ~60-90 m off and lower (DEM 2503 vs 2498). No gallery photo shows river from an RV pad; river shots are from the bank. Lettered rim sites are not RV rows on the map; 'Pathway to River' is a walk-down.

name: Clear Creek Reservoir SWA
evidence: Esri z19 (cc4, cc5, rendered, slightly hazy): SE spur and southern open pull-outs reach ~15-20 m of Clear Creek through scattered conifers and brush, not a continuous screen; reservoir ~150 m east. No site map or official site photos exist; pads are undesignated pull-outs.

name: Estes Park KOA
evidence: KOA RV photo (media fe723310) looks SW from the sites: Olympus Dam's riprap face fills the view, no water above it. Esri ko1: US-34, a commercial building and the embankment lie between. None of 18 KOA RV photos shows the lake; KOA sells 'mountain views' and says Lake Estes is 'across the street'. Pads beside the dam, not on the lake.
